name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision on the financing of the annual action plan in favour of the United Republic of Tanzania for 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to fund development work in Tanzania for 2025. Parliament says the plan ignores serious problems there: a rigged election in October 2025, security forces killing more than 400 protesters, and the arrest of opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who faces a possible death sentence. Parliament wants a new plan that addresses these concerns and keeps money going to non-governmental organisations and civil society. The Commission has already paused the plan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw and rewrite its Tanzania funding plan.
- **Who it affects:** Tanzania's government, its people, and groups receiving European Union aid.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw the plan and propose a new one.
